-- List every entity that makes up an availability count, including entities that already have a value.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.data_quality_dashboard(
  p_domain_code text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_from_date date DEFAULT NULL,
  p_to_date date DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, data_quality, entity_instances, metadata_register, golden_master, pg_catalog
AS $dashboard$
DECLARE
  v_domain text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_domain_code, '')), '');
  v_to date := COALESCE(p_to_date, CURRENT_DATE);
  v_from date := COALESCE(p_from_date, COALESCE(p_to_date, CURRENT_DATE) - 1);
  v_swap date;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout', '20000', true);
  IF v_from > v_to THEN
    v_swap := v_from;
    v_from := v_to;
    v_to := v_swap;
  END IF;

  WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT me.id, me.entity_code, me.entity_name, me.domain_code, me.template_id
    FROM entity_instances.master_entities me
    WHERE me.is_active IS TRUE
      AND me.client_id IN (
        SELECT cid
        FROM tenancy.current_client_ids() AS cid
        WHERE tenancy.has_permission(cid, 'entity.read')
      )
      AND CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenancy.entity_grants)
          THEN tenancy.has_entity_access(me.id, 'READ')
        ELSE TRUE
      END
      AND (v_domain IS NULL OR me.domain_code = v_domain)
  ),
  resolved AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (eav.entity_id, eav.attribute_id, snapshot.as_of)
      eav.entity_id,
      eav.attribute_id,
      snapshot.as_of,
      NULLIF(btrim(eav.golden_value), '') AS golden_value
    FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = eav.entity_id
    JOIN (
      VALUES (v_from), (v_to)
    ) AS snapshot(as_of) ON TRUE
    WHERE eav.system_to = '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
      AND eav.valid_from <= snapshot.as_of
      AND eav.valid_to >= snapshot.as_of
    ORDER BY eav.entity_id, eav.attribute_id, snapshot.as_of, eav.precedence_rank ASC, eav.valid_from DESC
  ),
  required_attr AS (
    SELECT s.id AS entity_id, s.entity_code, s.entity_name, s.domain_code,
           ar.id AS attribute_id, ar.attribute_code, ar.attribute_name
    FROM scoped s
    JOIN metadata_register.template_attribute_assignments taa
      ON taa.template_id = s.template_id
     AND taa.is_required IS TRUE
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = taa.attribute_id
    WHERE s.template_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT s.id, s.entity_code, s.entity_name, s.domain_code,
           ar.id, ar.attribute_code, ar.attribute_name
    FROM scoped s
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar
      ON ar.domain_code = s.domain_code
     AND ar.is_required IS TRUE
    WHERE s.template_id IS NULL
  ),
  missing AS (
    SELECT r.*
    FROM required_attr r
    LEFT JOIN resolved rv
      ON rv.entity_id = r.entity_id
     AND rv.attribute_id = r.attribute_id
     AND rv.as_of = v_to
     AND rv.golden_value IS NOT NULL
    WHERE rv.entity_id IS NULL
  ),
  value_map AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rv.entity_id,
           jsonb_object_agg(lower(ar.attribute_code), rv.golden_value) AS values
    FROM resolved rv
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = rv.attribute_id
    WHERE rv.as_of = v_to
      AND rv.golden_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rv.entity_id
  ),
  active_rules AS (
    SELECT r.id, r.rule_code, r.rule_name, r.domain_code, r.rule_type, r.rule_severity,
           r.rule_expression, r.rule_description, ar.attribute_code, ar.attribute_name,
           data_quality.evaluate_rule_expression(r.rule_expression, '{}'::jsonb, v_to) AS probe
    FROM data_quality.dq_rules r
    LEFT JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = r.attribute_id
    WHERE r.is_active IS TRUE
      AND (v_domain IS NULL OR r.domain_code IS NULL OR r.domain_code = v_domain)
  ),
  accepted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (ex.rule_id, ex.entity_id)
           ex.rule_id, ex.entity_id, ex.status, ex.resolution_notes
    FROM data_quality.dq_exceptions ex
    WHERE ex.status IN ('WAIVED', 'FALSE_POSITIVE')
      AND ex.valid_from <= v_to
      AND ex.valid_to >= v_to
      AND ex.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM scoped)
    ORDER BY ex.rule_id, ex.entity_id, ex.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, ex.detected_at DESC
  ),
  rule_checks AS (
    SELECT aru.id AS rule_id,
           s.id AS entity_id,
           s.entity_code,
           s.entity_name,
           s.domain_code,
           CASE
             WHEN aru.attribute_code IS NOT NULL
              AND NOT COALESCE(vm.values, '{}'::jsonb) ? lower(aru.attribute_code)
              AND aru.rule_expression ~* ('^' || aru.attribute_code || '[[:space:]]+IS[[:space:]]+NULL[[:space:]]+OR[[:space:]]')
             THEN jsonb_build_object('passed', true, 'evaluated', true, 'message', NULL, 'actualValue', NULL)
             ELSE data_quality.evaluate_rule_expression(aru.rule_expression, COALESCE(vm.values, '{}'::jsonb), v_to)
           END AS result
    FROM active_rules aru
    JOIN scoped s ON aru.domain_code IS NULL OR s.domain_code = aru.domain_code
    LEFT JOIN value_map vm ON vm.entity_id = s.id
    WHERE COALESCE((aru.probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM accepted ax
        WHERE ax.rule_id = aru.id AND ax.entity_id = s.id
      )
  ),
  paired AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           attribute_id,
           max(golden_value) FILTER (WHERE as_of = v_from) AS previous_value,
           max(golden_value) FILTER (WHERE as_of = v_to) AS current_value
    FROM resolved
    GROUP BY entity_id, attribute_id
    HAVING max(golden_value) FILTER (WHERE as_of = v_from)
       IS DISTINCT FROM
       max(golden_value) FILTER (WHERE as_of = v_to)
  ),
  changes AS (
    SELECT p.entity_id,
           s.entity_code,
           s.entity_name,
           s.domain_code,
           ar.attribute_code,
           ar.attribute_name,
           ar.domain_code AS attribute_domain_code,
           p.previous_value,
           p.current_value
    FROM paired p
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = p.entity_id
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = p.attribute_id
  ),
  required_values AS (
    SELECT r.entity_id,
           r.entity_code,
           r.entity_name,
           r.domain_code,
           r.attribute_id,
           rv.golden_value
    FROM required_attr r
    LEFT JOIN resolved rv
      ON rv.entity_id = r.entity_id
     AND rv.attribute_id = r.attribute_id
     AND rv.as_of = v_to
     AND rv.golden_value IS NOT NULL
  ),
  availability_rows AS (
    SELECT ar.attribute_code AS "attributeCode",
           ar.attribute_name AS "attributeName",
           COALESCE(ar.domain_code, req.domain_code) AS "domainCode",
           count(DISTINCT req.entity_id)::int AS "requiredCount",
           count(DISTINCT req.entity_id) FILTER (WHERE req.golden_value IS NULL)::int AS "missingCount",
           round(
             100.0 * count(DISTINCT req.entity_id) FILTER (WHERE req.golden_value IS NOT NULL)
             / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT req.entity_id), 0),
             1
           ) AS "availabilityPercent",
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', req.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', req.entity_code,
                 'entityName', req.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', req.domain_code
               )
             ) FILTER (WHERE req.golden_value IS NULL),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS "missingEntities",
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', req.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', req.entity_code,
                 'entityName', req.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', req.domain_code,
                 'value', req.golden_value
               )
               ORDER BY (req.golden_value IS NULL) DESC, req.entity_name
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS "entities"
    FROM required_values req
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = req.attribute_id
    GROUP BY ar.attribute_code, ar.attribute_name, COALESCE(ar.domain_code, req.domain_code)
  ),
  quality_rows AS (
    SELECT aru.id AS "ruleId",
           aru.rule_code AS "ruleCode",
           aru.rule_name AS "ruleName",
           aru.rule_type AS "ruleType",
           aru.rule_severity AS "severity",
           aru.domain_code AS "domainCode",
           aru.rule_expression AS "ruleExpression",
           aru.rule_description AS "ruleDescription",
           aru.attribute_code AS "attributeCode",
           aru.attribute_name AS "attributeName",
           (SELECT count(*)::int FROM accepted ax WHERE ax.rule_id = aru.id) AS "acceptedCount",
           COALESCE((
             SELECT jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', me.id,
                 'entityCode', me.entity_code,
                 'entityName', me.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', me.domain_code,
                 'status', ax.status,
                 'notes', ax.resolution_notes
               )
               ORDER BY me.entity_name
             )
             FROM accepted ax
             JOIN entity_instances.master_entities me ON me.id = ax.entity_id
             WHERE ax.rule_id = aru.id
           ), '[]'::jsonb) AS "acceptedEntities",
           COALESCE((aru.probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false) AS "evaluated",
           CASE
             WHEN COALESCE((aru.probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false) THEN NULL
             ELSE aru.probe->>'message'
           END AS "evaluationMessage",
           count(rc.entity_id)::int AS "entityCount",
           count(rc.entity_id) FILTER (
             WHERE COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE
           )::int AS "failingCount",
           count(rc.entity_id) FILTER (
             WHERE COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false)
           )::int AS "passingCount",
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', rc.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', rc.entity_code,
                 'entityName', rc.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', rc.domain_code,
                 'attributeCode', aru.attribute_code,
                 'attributeName', aru.attribute_name,
                 'message', rc.result->>'message',
                 'actualValue', rc.result->>'actualValue'
               )
               ORDER BY rc.entity_name
             ) FILTER (
               WHERE rc.entity_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS "failingEntities"
    FROM active_rules aru
    LEFT JOIN rule_checks rc ON rc.rule_id = aru.id
    GROUP BY aru.id, aru.rule_code, aru.rule_name, aru.rule_type, aru.rule_severity,
             aru.domain_code, aru.rule_expression, aru.rule_description,
             aru.attribute_code, aru.attribute_name, aru.probe
  ),
  trajectory_rows AS (
    SELECT c.attribute_code AS "attributeCode",
           c.attribute_name AS "attributeName",
           c.attribute_domain_code AS "domainCode",
           count(*)::int AS "changeCount",
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'id', c.entity_id,
               'entityCode', c.entity_code,
               'entityName', c.entity_name,
               'domainCode', c.domain_code,
               'previousValue', c.previous_value,
               'currentValue', c.current_value
             )
             ORDER BY c.entity_name
           ) AS "changes"
    FROM changes c
    GROUP BY c.attribute_code, c.attribute_name, c.attribute_domain_code
  ),
  entity_missing AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           count(*)::int AS missing_count,
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'attributeCode', attribute_code,
               'attributeName', attribute_name
             )
             ORDER BY attribute_name
           ) AS missing_attributes
    FROM missing
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_required AS (
    SELECT entity_id, count(*)::int AS required_count
    FROM required_attr
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_rules AS (
    SELECT rc.entity_id,
           count(*)::int AS rule_count,
           count(*) FILTER (
             WHERE COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE
           )::int AS failing_count,
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'ruleId', aru.id,
                 'ruleCode', aru.rule_code,
                 'ruleName', aru.rule_name,
                 'severity', aru.rule_severity,
                 'attributeCode', aru.attribute_code,
                 'attributeName', aru.attribute_name,
                 'message', rc.result->>'message',
                 'actualValue', rc.result->>'actualValue'
               )
               ORDER BY aru.rule_name
             ) FILTER (
               WHERE COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS failing_rules
    FROM rule_checks rc
    JOIN active_rules aru ON aru.id = rc.rule_id
    GROUP BY rc.entity_id
  ),
  entity_accepted AS (
    SELECT ax.entity_id,
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'ruleId', aru.id,
                 'ruleCode', aru.rule_code,
                 'ruleName', aru.rule_name,
                 'severity', aru.rule_severity,
                 'attributeCode', aru.attribute_code,
                 'attributeName', aru.attribute_name,
                 'status', ax.status,
                 'notes', ax.resolution_notes
               )
               ORDER BY aru.rule_name
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS accepted_rules
    FROM accepted ax
    JOIN active_rules aru ON aru.id = ax.rule_id
    GROUP BY ax.entity_id
  ),
  entity_changes AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           count(*)::int AS change_count,
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'attributeCode', attribute_code,
               'attributeName', attribute_name,
               'previousValue', previous_value,
               'currentValue', current_value
             )
             ORDER BY attribute_name
           ) AS changes
    FROM changes
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_rows AS (
    SELECT s.id AS "id",
           s.entity_code AS "entityCode",
           s.entity_name AS "entityName",
           s.domain_code AS "domainCode",
           COALESCE(er.required_count, 0) AS "requiredCount",
           COALESCE(em.missing_count, 0) AS "missingCount",
           CASE
             WHEN COALESCE(er.required_count, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE round(100.0 * (er.required_count - COALESCE(em.missing_count, 0)) / er.required_count, 1)
           END AS "availabilityPercent",
           COALESCE(em.missing_attributes, '[]'::jsonb) AS "missingAttributes",
           COALESCE(ru.rule_count, 0) AS "ruleCount",
           COALESCE(ru.failing_count, 0) AS "failingRuleCount",
           CASE
             WHEN COALESCE(ru.rule_count, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE round(100.0 * (ru.rule_count - COALESCE(ru.failing_count, 0)) / ru.rule_count, 1)
           END AS "qualityPercent",
           COALESCE(ru.failing_rules, '[]'::jsonb) AS "failingRules",
           COALESCE(ea.accepted_rules, '[]'::jsonb) AS "acceptedRules",
           COALESCE(ec.change_count, 0) AS "changeCount",
           COALESCE(ec.changes, '[]'::jsonb) AS "changes"
    FROM scoped s
    LEFT JOIN entity_required er ON er.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_missing em ON em.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_rules ru ON ru.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_accepted ea ON ea.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_changes ec ON ec.entity_id = s.id
  ),
  summary AS (
    SELECT
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM scoped) AS entity_count,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM required_attr) AS required_slots,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM missing) AS missing_slots,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id)::int FROM missing) AS entities_missing,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM active_rules WHERE COALESCE((probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false)) AS rules_evaluated,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM rule_checks WHERE COALESCE((result->>'passed')::boolean, false)) AS passing_checks,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM rule_checks WHERE COALESCE((result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE) AS failing_checks,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id)::int FROM rule_checks WHERE COALESCE((result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE) AS entities_failing,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT attribute_code)::int FROM changes) AS changed_attributes,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id)::int FROM changes) AS changed_entities,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM changes) AS attribute_changes,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM entity_rows
        WHERE "missingCount" = 0 AND "failingRuleCount" = 0 AND "changeCount" = 0) AS clear_entities
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'fromDate', to_char(v_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'toDate', to_char(v_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'domains', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(domain_code ORDER BY domain_code)
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT domain_code
        FROM entity_instances.master_entities
        WHERE is_active IS TRUE
          AND domain_code IS NOT NULL
          AND client_id IN (
            SELECT cid
            FROM tenancy.current_client_ids() AS cid
            WHERE tenancy.has_permission(cid, 'entity.read')
          )
      ) d
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'summary', (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'entityCount', entity_count,
        'requiredSlots', required_slots,
        'populatedSlots', required_slots - missing_slots,
        'missingSlots', missing_slots,
        'entitiesMissingRequired', entities_missing,
        'availabilityPercent', CASE
          WHEN required_slots = 0 THEN NULL
          ELSE round(100.0 * (required_slots - missing_slots) / required_slots, 1)
        END,
        'rulesEvaluated', rules_evaluated,
        'passingChecks', passing_checks,
        'failingChecks', failing_checks,
        'entitiesFailingRules', entities_failing,
        'qualityPercent', CASE
          WHEN passing_checks + failing_checks = 0 THEN NULL
          WHEN failing_checks = 0 THEN 100.0
          ELSE least(99.9, round(100.0 * passing_checks / (passing_checks + failing_checks), 1))
        END,
        'changedAttributeCount', changed_attributes,
        'changedEntityCount', changed_entities,
        'attributeChangeCount', attribute_changes,
        'clearEntityCount', clear_entities
      )
      FROM summary
    ),
    'availability', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a."missingCount" DESC, a."attributeName")
      FROM availability_rows a
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'quality', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY q."failingCount" DESC, q."ruleName")
      FROM quality_rows q
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'trajectory', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t."changeCount" DESC, t."attributeName")
      FROM trajectory_rows t
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'entities', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY (e."missingCount" + e."failingRuleCount" + e."changeCount") DESC, e."entityName")
      FROM entity_rows e
      WHERE e."missingCount" > 0 OR e."failingRuleCount" > 0 OR e."changeCount" > 0
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  INTO v_result;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$dashboard$;
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.data_quality_dashboard(text, date, date) IS
  'Availability of required attributes, DQ rule failures, and golden-value changes between two as-of dates. Availability rows include every required entity and its current value. Waived and false-positive exceptions are excluded.';

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.data_quality_dashboard(text, date, date) TO authenticated, service_role;

      FROM (
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(

          'data_type', data_type,
          'description', description,
          'unit_of_measure', unit_of_measure,

          'reference_domain_code', reference_domain_code,

          'is_derived', is_derived,
          'derivation_type', derivation_type,
          'derivation_formula', derivation_formula,
          'derivation_dependencies', derivation_dependencies,
          'display_format', display_format,
          'list_values', list_values,
          'validation_rules', validation_rules,
          'default_value', default_value,
          'display_section', display_section,
          'display_group', display_group,
          'is_editable', is_editable,
          'is_visible', is_visible,
          'aggregation_type', COALESCE(aggregation_type, 'NONE'),

        WHERE (p_domain_code IS NULL OR domain_code = p_domain_code OR domain_code IS NULL)
        ORDER BY attribute_code
      ) sub
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_result;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.data_quality_dashboard(
  p_domain_code text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_from_date date DEFAULT NULL,
  p_to_date date DEFAULT NULL
) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, data_quality, entity_instances, metadata_register, golden_master, pg_catalog
AS $dashboard$
DECLARE
  v_domain text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_domain_code, '')), '');
  v_to date := COALESCE(p_to_date, CURRENT_DATE);
  v_from date := COALESCE(p_from_date, COALESCE(p_to_date, CURRENT_DATE) - 1);
  v_swap date;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout', '45000', true);
  IF v_from > v_to THEN
    v_swap := v_from;
    v_from := v_to;
    v_to := v_swap;
  END IF;

  WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT me.id, me.entity_code, me.entity_name, me.domain_code, me.template_id
    FROM entity_instances.master_entities me
    WHERE me.is_active IS TRUE
      AND me.client_id IN (
        SELECT cid
        FROM tenancy.current_client_ids() AS cid
        WHERE tenancy.has_permission(cid, 'entity.read')
      )
      AND CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenancy.entity_grants)
          THEN tenancy.has_entity_access(me.id, 'READ')
        ELSE TRUE
      END
      AND (v_domain IS NULL OR me.domain_code = v_domain)
  ),
  resolved AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (eav.entity_id, eav.attribute_id, snapshot.as_of)
      eav.entity_id,
      eav.attribute_id,
      snapshot.as_of,
      NULLIF(btrim(eav.golden_value), '') AS golden_value
    FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = eav.entity_id
    JOIN (
      VALUES (v_from), (v_to)
    ) AS snapshot(as_of) ON TRUE
    WHERE eav.system_to = '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
      AND eav.valid_from <= snapshot.as_of
      AND eav.valid_to >= snapshot.as_of
    ORDER BY eav.entity_id, eav.attribute_id, snapshot.as_of, eav.precedence_rank ASC, eav.valid_from DESC
  ),
  required_attr AS (
    SELECT s.id AS entity_id, s.entity_code, s.entity_name, s.domain_code,
           ar.id AS attribute_id, ar.attribute_code, ar.attribute_name
    FROM scoped s
    JOIN metadata_register.template_attribute_assignments taa
      ON taa.template_id = s.template_id
     AND taa.is_required IS TRUE
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = taa.attribute_id
    WHERE s.template_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT s.id, s.entity_code, s.entity_name, s.domain_code,
           ar.id, ar.attribute_code, ar.attribute_name
    FROM scoped s
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar
      ON ar.domain_code = s.domain_code
     AND ar.is_required IS TRUE
    WHERE s.template_id IS NULL
  ),
  missing AS (
    SELECT r.*
    FROM required_attr r
    LEFT JOIN resolved rv
      ON rv.entity_id = r.entity_id
     AND rv.attribute_id = r.attribute_id
     AND rv.as_of = v_to
     AND rv.golden_value IS NOT NULL
    WHERE rv.entity_id IS NULL
  ),
  value_map AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rv.entity_id,
           jsonb_object_agg(lower(ar.attribute_code), rv.golden_value) AS values
    FROM resolved rv
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = rv.attribute_id
    WHERE rv.as_of = v_to
      AND rv.golden_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rv.entity_id
  ),
  active_rules AS (
    SELECT r.id, r.rule_code, r.rule_name, r.domain_code, r.rule_type, r.rule_severity,
           r.rule_expression, r.rule_description, ar.attribute_code, ar.attribute_name,
           data_quality.evaluate_rule_expression(r.rule_expression, '{}'::jsonb, v_to) AS probe
    FROM data_quality.dq_rules r
    LEFT JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = r.attribute_id
    WHERE r.is_active IS TRUE
      AND (v_domain IS NULL OR r.domain_code IS NULL OR r.domain_code = v_domain)
  ),
  accepted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (ex.rule_id, ex.entity_id)
           ex.rule_id, ex.entity_id, ex.status, ex.resolution_notes
    FROM data_quality.dq_exceptions ex
    WHERE ex.status IN ('WAIVED', 'FALSE_POSITIVE')
      AND ex.valid_from <= v_to
      AND ex.valid_to >= v_to
      AND ex.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM scoped)
    ORDER BY ex.rule_id, ex.entity_id, ex.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, ex.detected_at DESC
  ),
  rule_checks AS (
    SELECT aru.id AS rule_id,
           s.id AS entity_id,
           s.entity_code,
           s.entity_name,
           s.domain_code,
           CASE
             WHEN aru.attribute_code IS NOT NULL
              AND NOT jsonb_exists(COALESCE(vm.values, '{}'::jsonb), lower(aru.attribute_code))
              AND aru.rule_expression ~* ('^' || aru.attribute_code || '[[:space:]]+IS[[:space:]]+NULL[[:space:]]+OR[[:space:]]')
             THEN jsonb_build_object('passed', true, 'evaluated', true, 'message', NULL, 'actualValue', NULL)
             ELSE data_quality.evaluate_rule_expression(aru.rule_expression, COALESCE(vm.values, '{}'::jsonb), v_to)
           END AS result
    FROM active_rules aru
    JOIN scoped s ON aru.domain_code IS NULL OR s.domain_code = aru.domain_code
    LEFT JOIN value_map vm ON vm.entity_id = s.id
    WHERE COALESCE((aru.probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM accepted ax
        WHERE ax.rule_id = aru.id AND ax.entity_id = s.id
      )
  ),
  prior_value_map AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rv.entity_id,
           jsonb_object_agg(lower(ar.attribute_code), rv.golden_value) AS values
    FROM resolved rv
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = rv.attribute_id
    WHERE v_from <> v_to
      AND rv.as_of = v_from
      AND rv.golden_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rv.entity_id
  ),
  prior_checks AS (
    SELECT aru.id AS rule_id,
           s.id AS entity_id,
           CASE
             WHEN aru.attribute_code IS NOT NULL
              AND NOT jsonb_exists(COALESCE(vm.values, '{}'::jsonb), lower(aru.attribute_code))
              AND aru.rule_expression ~* ('^' || aru.attribute_code || '[[:space:]]+IS[[:space:]]+NULL[[:space:]]+OR[[:space:]]')
             THEN jsonb_build_object('passed', true, 'evaluated', true, 'message', NULL, 'actualValue', NULL)
             ELSE data_quality.evaluate_rule_expression(aru.rule_expression, COALESCE(vm.values, '{}'::jsonb), v_from)
           END AS result
    FROM active_rules aru
    JOIN scoped s ON aru.domain_code IS NULL OR s.domain_code = aru.domain_code
    LEFT JOIN prior_value_map vm ON vm.entity_id = s.id
    WHERE v_from <> v_to
      AND COALESCE((aru.probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false)
  ),
  rule_shift AS (
    SELECT rc.rule_id,
           rc.entity_id,
           rc.entity_code,
           rc.entity_name,
           rc.domain_code,
           COALESCE((pc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) AS prior_passed,
           COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) AS current_passed,
           pc.result->>'actualValue' AS previous_value,
           rc.result->>'actualValue' AS current_value
    FROM rule_checks rc
    JOIN prior_checks pc ON pc.rule_id = rc.rule_id AND pc.entity_id = rc.entity_id
  ),
  paired AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           attribute_id,
           max(golden_value) FILTER (WHERE as_of = v_from) AS previous_value,
           max(golden_value) FILTER (WHERE as_of = v_to) AS current_value
    FROM resolved
    GROUP BY entity_id, attribute_id
    HAVING max(golden_value) FILTER (WHERE as_of = v_from)
       IS DISTINCT FROM
       max(golden_value) FILTER (WHERE as_of = v_to)
  ),
  changes AS (
    SELECT p.entity_id,
           s.entity_code,
           s.entity_name,
           s.domain_code,
           ar.attribute_code,
           ar.attribute_name,
           ar.domain_code AS attribute_domain_code,
           p.previous_value,
           p.current_value
    FROM paired p
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = p.entity_id
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = p.attribute_id
  ),
  required_values AS (
    SELECT r.entity_id,
           r.entity_code,
           r.entity_name,
           r.domain_code,
           r.attribute_id,
           rv.golden_value,
           fr.golden_value AS previous_value,
           fr.golden_value IS NOT NULL AS present_from,
           rv.golden_value IS NOT NULL AS present_to
    FROM required_attr r
    LEFT JOIN resolved rv
      ON rv.entity_id = r.entity_id
     AND rv.attribute_id = r.attribute_id
     AND rv.as_of = v_to
     AND rv.golden_value IS NOT NULL
    LEFT JOIN resolved fr
      ON fr.entity_id = r.entity_id
     AND fr.attribute_id = r.attribute_id
     AND fr.as_of = v_from
     AND fr.golden_value IS NOT NULL
  ),
  availability_rows AS (
    SELECT ar.attribute_code AS "attributeCode",
           ar.attribute_name AS "attributeName",
           COALESCE(ar.domain_code, req.domain_code) AS "domainCode",
           count(DISTINCT req.entity_id)::int AS "requiredCount",
           count(DISTINCT req.entity_id) FILTER (WHERE req.golden_value IS NULL)::int AS "missingCount",
           round(
             100.0 * count(DISTINCT req.entity_id) FILTER (WHERE req.golden_value IS NOT NULL)
             / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT req.entity_id), 0),
             1
           ) AS "availabilityPercent",
           count(DISTINCT req.entity_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT req.present_from AND req.present_to)::int AS "resolvedCount",
           count(DISTINCT req.entity_id) FILTER (WHERE req.present_from AND NOT req.present_to)::int AS "introducedCount",
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', req.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', req.entity_code,
                 'entityName', req.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', req.domain_code
               )
             ) FILTER (WHERE req.golden_value IS NULL),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS "missingEntities",
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', req.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', req.entity_code,
                 'entityName', req.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', req.domain_code,
                 'previousValue', NULL,
                 'currentValue', req.golden_value
               )
             ) FILTER (WHERE NOT req.present_from AND req.present_to),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS "resolvedEntities",
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', req.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', req.entity_code,
                 'entityName', req.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', req.domain_code,
                 'previousValue', req.previous_value,
                 'currentValue', NULL
               )
             ) FILTER (WHERE req.present_from AND NOT req.present_to),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS "introducedEntities",
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', req.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', req.entity_code,
                 'entityName', req.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', req.domain_code,
                 'value', req.golden_value
               )
               ORDER BY (req.golden_value IS NULL) DESC, req.entity_name
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS "entities"
    FROM required_values req
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = req.attribute_id
    GROUP BY ar.attribute_code, ar.attribute_name, COALESCE(ar.domain_code, req.domain_code)
  ),
  quality_rows AS (
    SELECT aru.id AS "ruleId",
           aru.rule_code AS "ruleCode",
           aru.rule_name AS "ruleName",
           aru.rule_type AS "ruleType",
           aru.rule_severity AS "severity",
           aru.domain_code AS "domainCode",
           aru.rule_expression AS "ruleExpression",
           aru.rule_description AS "ruleDescription",
           aru.attribute_code AS "attributeCode",
           aru.attribute_name AS "attributeName",
           (SELECT count(*)::int FROM accepted ax WHERE ax.rule_id = aru.id) AS "acceptedCount",
           COALESCE((
             SELECT jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', me.id,
                 'entityCode', me.entity_code,
                 'entityName', me.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', me.domain_code,
                 'status', ax.status,
                 'notes', ax.resolution_notes
               )
               ORDER BY me.entity_name
             )
             FROM accepted ax
             JOIN entity_instances.master_entities me ON me.id = ax.entity_id
             WHERE ax.rule_id = aru.id
           ), '[]'::jsonb) AS "acceptedEntities",
           COALESCE((aru.probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false) AS "evaluated",
           CASE
             WHEN COALESCE((aru.probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false) THEN NULL
             ELSE aru.probe->>'message'
           END AS "evaluationMessage",
           count(rc.entity_id)::int AS "entityCount",
           count(rc.entity_id) FILTER (
             WHERE COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE
           )::int AS "failingCount",
           count(rc.entity_id) FILTER (
             WHERE COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false)
           )::int AS "passingCount",
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', rc.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', rc.entity_code,
                 'entityName', rc.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', rc.domain_code,
                 'attributeCode', aru.attribute_code,
                 'attributeName', aru.attribute_name,
                 'message', rc.result->>'message',
                 'actualValue', rc.result->>'actualValue'
               )
               ORDER BY rc.entity_name
             ) FILTER (
               WHERE rc.entity_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS "failingEntities",
           COALESCE((SELECT count(*)::int FROM rule_shift rs WHERE rs.rule_id = aru.id AND NOT rs.prior_passed AND rs.current_passed), 0) AS "resolvedCount",
           COALESCE((SELECT count(*)::int FROM rule_shift rs WHERE rs.rule_id = aru.id AND rs.prior_passed AND NOT rs.current_passed), 0) AS "introducedCount",
           COALESCE((
             SELECT jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', rs.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', rs.entity_code,
                 'entityName', rs.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', rs.domain_code,
                 'previousValue', rs.previous_value,
                 'currentValue', rs.current_value
               )
               ORDER BY rs.entity_name
             )
             FROM rule_shift rs
             WHERE rs.rule_id = aru.id AND NOT rs.prior_passed AND rs.current_passed
           ), '[]'::jsonb) AS "resolvedEntities",
           COALESCE((
             SELECT jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', rs.entity_id,
                 'entityCode', rs.entity_code,
                 'entityName', rs.entity_name,
                 'domainCode', rs.domain_code,
                 'previousValue', rs.previous_value,
                 'currentValue', rs.current_value
               )
               ORDER BY rs.entity_name
             )
             FROM rule_shift rs
             WHERE rs.rule_id = aru.id AND rs.prior_passed AND NOT rs.current_passed
           ), '[]'::jsonb) AS "introducedEntities"
    FROM active_rules aru
    LEFT JOIN rule_checks rc ON rc.rule_id = aru.id
    GROUP BY aru.id, aru.rule_code, aru.rule_name, aru.rule_type, aru.rule_severity,
             aru.domain_code, aru.rule_expression, aru.rule_description,
             aru.attribute_code, aru.attribute_name, aru.probe
  ),
  trajectory_rows AS (
    SELECT c.attribute_code AS "attributeCode",
           c.attribute_name AS "attributeName",
           c.attribute_domain_code AS "domainCode",
           count(*)::int AS "changeCount",
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'id', c.entity_id,
               'entityCode', c.entity_code,
               'entityName', c.entity_name,
               'domainCode', c.domain_code,
               'previousValue', c.previous_value,
               'currentValue', c.current_value
             )
             ORDER BY c.entity_name
           ) AS "changes"
    FROM changes c
    GROUP BY c.attribute_code, c.attribute_name, c.attribute_domain_code
  ),
  open_source_values AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (eav.entity_id, eav.attribute_id, eav.source_id)
           eav.entity_id,
           eav.attribute_id,
           NULLIF(btrim(eav.golden_value), '') AS golden_value,
           eav.golden_value_numeric,
           eav.precedence_rank,
           eav.is_manual_override,
           eav.override_reason,
           sr.source_code,
           sr.source_name
    FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = eav.entity_id
    JOIN entity_instances.source_registry sr ON sr.id = eav.source_id
    WHERE eav.system_to = '9999-12-31 23:59:59'
      AND eav.valid_from <= v_to
      AND eav.valid_to >= v_to
      AND NULLIF(btrim(eav.golden_value), '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY eav.entity_id, eav.attribute_id, eav.source_id, eav.precedence_rank ASC, eav.valid_from DESC
  ),
  manual_current AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_id, attribute_id)
           entity_id, attribute_id, golden_value, golden_value_numeric, override_reason
    FROM open_source_values
    WHERE is_manual_override IS TRUE OR source_code = 'MANUAL'
    ORDER BY entity_id, attribute_id, precedence_rank ASC, golden_value
  ),
  priority_current AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_id, attribute_id)
           entity_id, attribute_id, golden_value, golden_value_numeric, source_code, source_name
    FROM open_source_values
    WHERE COALESCE(is_manual_override, false) IS NOT TRUE
      AND source_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'MANUAL'
    ORDER BY entity_id, attribute_id, precedence_rank ASC, golden_value
  ),
  override_matches AS (
    SELECT s.id AS entity_id,
           s.entity_code,
           s.entity_name,
           s.domain_code,
           ar.attribute_code,
           ar.attribute_name,
           m.golden_value AS override_value,
           m.override_reason,
           p.source_code AS priority_source_code,
           p.source_name AS priority_source_name,
           p.golden_value AS priority_value
    FROM manual_current m
    JOIN priority_current p
      ON p.entity_id = m.entity_id
     AND p.attribute_id = m.attribute_id
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = m.entity_id
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = m.attribute_id
    WHERE data_quality.values_match(m.golden_value, p.golden_value)
       OR (
         m.golden_value_numeric IS NOT NULL
         AND p.golden_value_numeric IS NOT NULL
         AND m.golden_value_numeric = p.golden_value_numeric
       )
  ),
  entity_missing AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           count(*)::int AS missing_count,
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'attributeCode', attribute_code,
               'attributeName', attribute_name
             )
             ORDER BY attribute_name
           ) AS missing_attributes
    FROM missing
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_required AS (
    SELECT entity_id, count(*)::int AS required_count
    FROM required_attr
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_rules AS (
    SELECT rc.entity_id,
           count(*)::int AS rule_count,
           count(*) FILTER (
             WHERE COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE
           )::int AS failing_count,
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'ruleId', aru.id,
                 'ruleCode', aru.rule_code,
                 'ruleName', aru.rule_name,
                 'severity', aru.rule_severity,
                 'attributeCode', aru.attribute_code,
                 'attributeName', aru.attribute_name,
                 'message', rc.result->>'message',
                 'actualValue', rc.result->>'actualValue'
               )
               ORDER BY aru.rule_name
             ) FILTER (
               WHERE COALESCE((rc.result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS failing_rules
    FROM rule_checks rc
    JOIN active_rules aru ON aru.id = rc.rule_id
    GROUP BY rc.entity_id
  ),
  entity_accepted AS (
    SELECT ax.entity_id,
           COALESCE(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'ruleId', aru.id,
                 'ruleCode', aru.rule_code,
                 'ruleName', aru.rule_name,
                 'severity', aru.rule_severity,
                 'attributeCode', aru.attribute_code,
                 'attributeName', aru.attribute_name,
                 'status', ax.status,
                 'notes', ax.resolution_notes
               )
               ORDER BY aru.rule_name
             ),
             '[]'::jsonb
           ) AS accepted_rules
    FROM accepted ax
    JOIN active_rules aru ON aru.id = ax.rule_id
    GROUP BY ax.entity_id
  ),
  entity_availability_movement AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT present_from AND present_to)::int AS resolved_count,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE present_from AND NOT present_to)::int AS introduced_count
    FROM required_values
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_quality_movement AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT prior_passed AND current_passed)::int AS resolved_count,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE prior_passed AND NOT current_passed)::int AS introduced_count
    FROM rule_shift
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_override_matches AS (
    SELECT entity_id, count(*)::int AS match_count
    FROM override_matches
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_changes AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           count(*)::int AS change_count,
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'attributeCode', attribute_code,
               'attributeName', attribute_name,
               'previousValue', previous_value,
               'currentValue', current_value
             )
             ORDER BY attribute_name
           ) AS changes
    FROM changes
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
  entity_rows AS (
    SELECT s.id AS "id",
           s.entity_code AS "entityCode",
           s.entity_name AS "entityName",
           s.domain_code AS "domainCode",
           COALESCE(er.required_count, 0) AS "requiredCount",
           COALESCE(em.missing_count, 0) AS "missingCount",
           CASE
             WHEN COALESCE(er.required_count, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE round(100.0 * (er.required_count - COALESCE(em.missing_count, 0)) / er.required_count, 1)
           END AS "availabilityPercent",
           COALESCE(em.missing_attributes, '[]'::jsonb) AS "missingAttributes",
           COALESCE(ru.rule_count, 0) AS "ruleCount",
           COALESCE(ru.failing_count, 0) AS "failingRuleCount",
           CASE
             WHEN COALESCE(ru.rule_count, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE round(100.0 * (ru.rule_count - COALESCE(ru.failing_count, 0)) / ru.rule_count, 1)
           END AS "qualityPercent",
           COALESCE(ru.failing_rules, '[]'::jsonb) AS "failingRules",
           COALESCE(ea.accepted_rules, '[]'::jsonb) AS "acceptedRules",
           COALESCE(ec.change_count, 0) AS "changeCount",
           COALESCE(ec.changes, '[]'::jsonb) AS "changes",
           COALESCE(am.resolved_count, 0) AS "availabilityResolvedCount",
           COALESCE(am.introduced_count, 0) AS "availabilityIntroducedCount",
           COALESCE(qm.resolved_count, 0) AS "qualityResolvedCount",
           COALESCE(qm.introduced_count, 0) AS "qualityIntroducedCount",
           COALESCE(om.match_count, 0) AS "overrideMatchCount"
    FROM scoped s
    LEFT JOIN entity_required er ON er.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_missing em ON em.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_rules ru ON ru.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_accepted ea ON ea.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_changes ec ON ec.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_availability_movement am ON am.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_quality_movement qm ON qm.entity_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN entity_override_matches om ON om.entity_id = s.id
  ),
  summary AS (
    SELECT
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM scoped) AS entity_count,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM required_attr) AS required_slots,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM missing) AS missing_slots,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id)::int FROM missing) AS entities_missing,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM active_rules WHERE COALESCE((probe->>'evaluated')::boolean, false)) AS rules_evaluated,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM rule_checks WHERE COALESCE((result->>'passed')::boolean, false)) AS passing_checks,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM rule_checks WHERE COALESCE((result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE) AS failing_checks,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id)::int FROM rule_checks WHERE COALESCE((result->>'passed')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE) AS entities_failing,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT attribute_code)::int FROM changes) AS changed_attributes,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT entity_id)::int FROM changes) AS changed_entities,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM changes) AS attribute_changes,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM entity_rows
        WHERE "missingCount" = 0 AND "failingRuleCount" = 0 AND "changeCount" = 0 AND "overrideMatchCount" = 0) AS clear_entities,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM required_values WHERE NOT present_from AND present_to) AS availability_resolved,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM required_values WHERE present_from AND NOT present_to) AS availability_introduced,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM rule_shift WHERE NOT prior_passed AND current_passed) AS quality_resolved,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM rule_shift WHERE prior_passed AND NOT current_passed) AS quality_introduced,
      (SELECT count(*)::int FROM override_matches) AS override_match_count
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'fromDate', to_char(v_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'toDate', to_char(v_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'domains', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(domain_code ORDER BY domain_code)
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT domain_code
        FROM entity_instances.master_entities
        WHERE is_active IS TRUE
          AND domain_code IS NOT NULL
          AND client_id IN (
            SELECT cid
            FROM tenancy.current_client_ids() AS cid
            WHERE tenancy.has_permission(cid, 'entity.read')
          )
      ) d
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'summary', (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'entityCount', entity_count,
        'requiredSlots', required_slots,
        'populatedSlots', required_slots - missing_slots,
        'missingSlots', missing_slots,
        'entitiesMissingRequired', entities_missing,
        'availabilityPercent', CASE
          WHEN required_slots = 0 THEN NULL
          ELSE round(100.0 * (required_slots - missing_slots) / required_slots, 1)
        END,
        'rulesEvaluated', rules_evaluated,
        'passingChecks', passing_checks,
        'failingChecks', failing_checks,
        'entitiesFailingRules', entities_failing,
        'qualityPercent', CASE
          WHEN passing_checks + failing_checks = 0 THEN NULL
          WHEN failing_checks = 0 THEN 100.0
          ELSE least(99.9, round(100.0 * passing_checks / (passing_checks + failing_checks), 1))
        END,
        'changedAttributeCount', changed_attributes,
        'changedEntityCount', changed_entities,
        'attributeChangeCount', attribute_changes,
        'clearEntityCount', clear_entities,
        'availabilityResolvedCount', availability_resolved,
        'availabilityIntroducedCount', availability_introduced,
        'qualityResolvedCount', quality_resolved,
        'qualityIntroducedCount', quality_introduced,
        'overrideMatchCount', override_match_count
      )
      FROM summary
    ),
    'availability', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a."missingCount" DESC, a."attributeName")
      FROM availability_rows a
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'quality', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY q."failingCount" DESC, q."ruleName")
      FROM quality_rows q
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'trajectory', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t."changeCount" DESC, t."attributeName")
      FROM trajectory_rows t
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'overrideMatches', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', o.entity_id,
          'entityCode', o.entity_code,
          'entityName', o.entity_name,
          'domainCode', o.domain_code,
          'attributeCode', o.attribute_code,
          'attributeName', o.attribute_name,
          'overrideValue', o.override_value,
          'overrideReason', o.override_reason,
          'prioritySourceCode', o.priority_source_code,
          'prioritySourceName', o.priority_source_name,
          'priorityValue', o.priority_value
        )
        ORDER BY o.entity_name, o.attribute_name
      )
      FROM override_matches o
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'entities', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY (e."missingCount" + e."failingRuleCount" + e."changeCount" + e."overrideMatchCount") DESC, e."entityName")
      FROM entity_rows e
      WHERE e."missingCount" > 0 OR e."failingRuleCount" > 0 OR e."changeCount" > 0 OR e."overrideMatchCount" > 0
         OR e."availabilityResolvedCount" > 0 OR e."availabilityIntroducedCount" > 0
         OR e."qualityResolvedCount" > 0 OR e."qualityIntroducedCount" > 0
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  INTO v_result;

  RETURN v_result;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION golden_master.expression_batch_capable(p_calc_id UUID)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
AS $$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM metadata_register.calc_definitions cd
        WHERE cd.id = p_calc_id
          AND cd.evaluation_mode = 'MATERIALIZED'
          AND cd.calc_kind = 'EXPRESSION'
          AND cd.output_grain = 'ON_INPUT_CHANGE'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM metadata_register.calc_inputs ci
        WHERE ci.calc_definition_id = p_calc_id
          AND (
              ci.input_role <> 'OPERAND'
              OR (
                  ci.traversal <> 'SELF'
                  AND COALESCE(cardinality(ci.relationship_codes), 0) <> 1
              )
          )
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM metadata_register.calc_inputs ci
        WHERE ci.calc_definition_id = p_calc_id AND ci.input_role = 'OPERAND'
    );
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION golden_master.apply_expression_batch(p_job_ids UUID[])
RETURNS INTEGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_source UUID;
    v_rank INTEGER;
    v_open TIMESTAMPTZ := golden_master.open_system_to();
    v_ts TIMESTAMPTZ := clock_timestamp();
    v_changed INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
    IF COALESCE(cardinality(p_job_ids), 0) = 0 THEN
        RETURN 0;
    END IF;

    SELECT id, precedence_rank INTO v_source, v_rank
    FROM entity_instances.source_registry
    WHERE source_code = 'DERIVED';
    IF v_source IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'DERIVED source is not registered';
    END IF;

    PERFORM set_config('golden_master.suppress_calc_enqueue', '1', true);

    CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calc_batch_write (
        entity_id UUID,
        attribute_id UUID,
        valid_from DATE,
        valid_to DATE,
        value NUMERIC
    ) ON COMMIT DROP;
    TRUNCATE calc_batch_write;

    INSERT INTO calc_batch_write (entity_id, attribute_id, valid_from, valid_to, value)
    WITH jobs AS (
        SELECT i.entity_id, i.calc_attribute_id, i.window_start, i.window_end
        FROM golden_master.calc_invalidations i
        WHERE i.id = ANY (p_job_ids)
          AND i.window_start <= LEAST(i.window_end, CURRENT_DATE)
    ),
    fresh AS (
        SELECT s.entity_id, j.calc_attribute_id, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.value
        FROM jobs j
        JOIN golden_master.expression_batch_slices(p_job_ids) s ON s.entity_id = j.entity_id
        WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
    ),
    overlap AS (
        SELECT eav.entity_id, eav.attribute_id, eav.valid_from, eav.valid_to, eav.golden_value_numeric,
               j.window_start, j.window_end
        FROM jobs j
        JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
          ON eav.entity_id = j.entity_id
         AND eav.attribute_id = j.calc_attribute_id
         AND eav.source_id = v_source
         AND eav.system_to = v_open
         AND eav.valid_to >= j.window_start
         AND eav.valid_from <= j.window_end
    ),
    desired AS (
        SELECT entity_id, attribute_id, valid_from, (window_start - 1) AS valid_to, golden_value_numeric AS value
        FROM overlap
        WHERE valid_from < window_start AND golden_value_numeric IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity_id, attribute_id, (window_end + 1), valid_to, golden_value_numeric
        FROM overlap
        WHERE valid_to > window_end AND golden_value_numeric IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entity_id, calc_attribute_id, valid_from, valid_to, value FROM fresh
    ),
    current_rows AS (
        SELECT entity_id, attribute_id,
               jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(valid_from, valid_to, golden_value_numeric) ORDER BY valid_from, valid_to) AS signature
        FROM overlap
        GROUP BY entity_id, attribute_id
    ),
    desired_rows AS (
        SELECT entity_id, attribute_id,
               jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(valid_from, valid_to, value) ORDER BY valid_from, valid_to) AS signature
        FROM desired
        GROUP BY entity_id, attribute_id
    ),
    changed AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(d.entity_id, c.entity_id) AS entity_id,
               COALESCE(d.attribute_id, c.attribute_id) AS attribute_id
        FROM desired_rows d
        FULL JOIN current_rows c USING (entity_id, attribute_id)
        WHERE d.signature IS DISTINCT FROM c.signature
    )
    SELECT d.entity_id, d.attribute_id, d.valid_from, d.valid_to, d.value
    FROM desired d
    JOIN changed c ON c.entity_id = d.entity_id AND c.attribute_id = d.attribute_id;

    UPDATE golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
    SET system_to = v_ts
    FROM golden_master.calc_invalidations i
    WHERE i.id = ANY (p_job_ids)
      AND i.window_start <= LEAST(i.window_end, CURRENT_DATE)
      AND eav.entity_id = i.entity_id
      AND eav.attribute_id = i.calc_attribute_id
      AND eav.source_id = v_source
      AND eav.system_to = v_open
      AND eav.valid_to >= i.window_start
      AND eav.valid_from <= i.window_end
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM calc_batch_write w
          WHERE w.entity_id = eav.entity_id AND w.attribute_id = eav.attribute_id
      );

    INSERT INTO golden_master.entity_attribute_values (
        entity_id, attribute_id, source_id, golden_value, golden_value_numeric,
        valid_from, valid_to, system_from, system_to, precedence_rank, is_manual_override
    )
    SELECT w.entity_id, w.attribute_id, v_source, w.value::TEXT, w.value,
           w.valid_from, w.valid_to, v_ts, v_open, v_rank, FALSE
    FROM calc_batch_write w;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_changed = ROW_COUNT;
    PERFORM set_config('golden_master.suppress_calc_enqueue', '0', true);
    RETURN v_changed;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        PERFORM set_config('golden_master.suppress_calc_enqueue', '0', true);
        RAISE;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION golden_master.apply_expression_batch(UUID[]) FROM PUBLIC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION golden_master.enqueue_batch_dependents(p_job_ids UUID[])
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
    CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calc_batch_dependents (
        calc_attribute_id UUID,
        entity_id UUID,
        window_start DATE,
        window_end DATE,
        cause_entity_id UUID,
        cause_attribute_code VARCHAR(100),
        cause_valid_from DATE
    ) ON COMMIT DROP;
    TRUNCATE calc_batch_dependents;

    INSERT INTO calc_batch_dependents
    SELECT cd.attribute_id,
           CASE
               WHEN ci.traversal = 'SELF' OR COALESCE(cardinality(ci.relationship_codes), 0) = 0 THEN w.entity_id
               WHEN ci.traversal = 'DOWN' THEN er.parent_entity_id
               ELSE er.child_entity_id
           END,
           MIN(i.window_start),
           MAX(CASE WHEN cd.time_impact = 'FORWARD' THEN DATE '9999-12-31' ELSE i.window_end END),
           (array_agg(w.entity_id))[1],
           ar.attribute_code,
           MIN(i.window_start)
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT entity_id, attribute_id FROM calc_batch_write
    ) w
    JOIN golden_master.calc_invalidations i ON i.entity_id = w.entity_id AND i.id = ANY (p_job_ids)
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = w.attribute_id
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_inputs ci ON ci.attribute_code = ar.attribute_code
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_definitions cd
      ON cd.id = ci.calc_definition_id
     AND cd.evaluation_mode = 'MATERIALIZED'
     AND cd.attribute_id <> w.attribute_id
    LEFT JOIN entity_instances.entity_relationships er
      ON ci.traversal <> 'SELF'
     AND COALESCE(cardinality(ci.relationship_codes), 0) = 1
     AND er.relationship_code = ci.relationship_codes[1]
     AND er.system_to = golden_master.open_system_to()
     AND er.valid_to >= i.window_start
     AND er.valid_from <= i.window_end
     AND (
          (ci.traversal = 'DOWN' AND er.child_entity_id = w.entity_id)
       OR (ci.traversal <> 'DOWN' AND er.parent_entity_id = w.entity_id)
     )
    GROUP BY cd.attribute_id, ar.attribute_code,
             CASE
                 WHEN ci.traversal = 'SELF' OR COALESCE(cardinality(ci.relationship_codes), 0) = 0 THEN w.entity_id
                 WHEN ci.traversal = 'DOWN' THEN er.parent_entity_id
                 ELSE er.child_entity_id
             END;

    INSERT INTO golden_master.calc_invalidations (
        calc_attribute_id, entity_id, window_start, window_end,
        cause_entity_id, cause_attribute_code, cause_valid_from
    )
    SELECT d.calc_attribute_id, d.entity_id, d.window_start, d.window_end,
           d.cause_entity_id, d.cause_attribute_code, d.cause_valid_from
    FROM calc_batch_dependents d
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM golden_master.calc_invalidations existing
        WHERE existing.calc_attribute_id = d.calc_attribute_id
          AND existing.entity_id = d.entity_id
          AND existing.status = 'PENDING'
    );

    UPDATE golden_master.calc_invalidations existing
    SET window_start = LEAST(existing.window_start, d.window_start),
        window_end = GREATEST(existing.window_end, d.window_end),
        not_before = NULL,
        cause_entity_id = d.cause_entity_id,
        cause_attribute_code = d.cause_attribute_code,
        cause_valid_from = d.cause_valid_from
    FROM calc_batch_dependents d
    WHERE existing.calc_attribute_id = d.calc_attribute_id
      AND existing.entity_id = d.entity_id
      AND existing.status = 'PENDING';
END;
$$;

ALTER FUNCTION golden_master.process_calc_invalidations(INTEGER, UUID)
    RENAME TO process_calc_invalidations_each;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION golden_master.process_calc_invalidations(
    p_limit INTEGER,
    p_entity_id UUID
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = golden_master, metadata_register, entity_instances, public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_limit INTEGER := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 500), 1), 5000);
    v_processed INTEGER := 0;
    v_failed INTEGER := 0;
    v_calc_id UUID;
    v_attribute_id UUID;
    v_ids UUID[];
    v_ready UUID[];
    v_rest JSONB;
BEGIN
    LOOP
        EXIT WHEN v_processed + v_failed >= v_limit;

        SELECT cd.id, cd.attribute_id
          INTO v_calc_id, v_attribute_id
        FROM metadata_register.calc_definitions cd
        WHERE golden_master.expression_batch_capable(cd.id)
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM golden_master.calc_invalidations i
              WHERE i.calc_attribute_id = cd.attribute_id
                AND i.status = 'PENDING'
                AND (i.not_before IS NULL OR i.not_before <= CURRENT_DATE)
                AND (p_entity_id IS NULL OR i.entity_id = p_entity_id)
          )
        ORDER BY golden_master.calc_depth(cd.attribute_id)
        LIMIT 1;

        EXIT WHEN v_calc_id IS NULL;

        WITH claimed AS (
            UPDATE golden_master.calc_invalidations i
            SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = clock_timestamp(), last_error = NULL
            WHERE i.id IN (
                SELECT pending.id
                FROM golden_master.calc_invalidations pending
                WHERE pending.calc_attribute_id = v_attribute_id
                  AND pending.status = 'PENDING'
                  AND (pending.not_before IS NULL OR pending.not_before <= CURRENT_DATE)
                  AND (p_entity_id IS NULL OR pending.entity_id = p_entity_id)
                ORDER BY pending.window_start, pending.enqueued_at
                LIMIT v_limit - v_processed - v_failed
                FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            )
            RETURNING i.id, i.window_start, i.window_end
        )
        SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(id), '{}'),
               COALESCE(array_agg(id) FILTER (
                   WHERE window_start <= LEAST(window_end, CURRENT_DATE)
               ), '{}')
          INTO v_ids, v_ready
        FROM claimed;

        EXIT WHEN COALESCE(cardinality(v_ids), 0) = 0;

        UPDATE golden_master.calc_invalidations
        SET status = 'PENDING', not_before = window_start, started_at = NULL
        WHERE id = ANY (v_ids)
          AND NOT (id = ANY (v_ready));

        BEGIN
            IF COALESCE(cardinality(v_ready), 0) > 0 THEN
                PERFORM golden_master.apply_expression_batch(v_ready);
                PERFORM golden_master.enqueue_batch_dependents(v_ready);
            END IF;
            UPDATE golden_master.calc_invalidations
            SET status = 'DONE', finished_at = clock_timestamp()
            WHERE id = ANY (v_ready);
            v_processed := v_processed + COALESCE(cardinality(v_ready), 0);
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN OTHERS THEN
                PERFORM set_config('golden_master.suppress_calc_enqueue', '0', true);
                UPDATE golden_master.calc_invalidations
                SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = SQLERRM, finished_at = clock_timestamp()
                WHERE id = ANY (v_ready);
                v_failed := v_failed + COALESCE(cardinality(v_ready), 0);
        END;
    END LOOP;

    IF v_processed + v_failed < v_limit THEN
        v_rest := golden_master.process_calc_invalidations_each(v_limit - v_processed - v_failed, p_entity_id);
        v_processed := v_processed + COALESCE((v_rest->>'processed')::INTEGER, 0);
        v_failed := v_failed + COALESCE((v_rest->>'failed')::INTEGER, 0);
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'processed', v_processed,
        'failed', v_failed,
        'pending', (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM golden_master.calc_invalidations
            WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
              AND (p_entity_id IS NULL OR entity_id = p_entity_id)
        )
    );
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION golden_master.enqueue_batch_dependents(UUID[]) FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION golden_master.process_calc_invalidations_each(INTEGER, UUID) FROM PUBLIC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION golden_master.aggregate_batch_slices(p_job_ids UUID[])
RETURNS TABLE(entity_id UUID, valid_from DATE, valid_to DATE, value NUMERIC)
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_fn TEXT;
    v_grain TEXT;
    v_traversal TEXT;
    v_codes TEXT[];
    v_measure VARCHAR(100);
    v_weight VARCHAR(100);
BEGIN
    SELECT cd.aggregate_fn, cd.output_grain, ci.traversal, ci.relationship_codes, ci.attribute_code
      INTO v_fn, v_grain, v_traversal, v_codes, v_measure
    FROM golden_master.calc_invalidations i
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_definitions cd ON cd.attribute_id = i.calc_attribute_id
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_inputs ci ON ci.calc_definition_id = cd.id AND ci.input_role = 'MEASURE'
    WHERE i.id = ANY (p_job_ids)
    LIMIT 1;

    SELECT attribute_code INTO v_weight
    FROM metadata_register.calc_inputs ci
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_definitions cd ON cd.id = ci.calc_definition_id
    JOIN golden_master.calc_invalidations i ON i.calc_attribute_id = cd.attribute_id
    WHERE i.id = ANY (p_job_ids) AND ci.input_role = 'WEIGHT'
    LIMIT 1;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (
        SELECT * FROM golden_master.period_batch_dates(p_job_ids, v_grain)
    ),
    codes AS (
        SELECT hop.code, hop.ordinal::INTEGER AS ord
        FROM unnest(COALESCE(v_codes, ARRAY[]::TEXT[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS hop(code, ordinal)
    ),
    walk AS (
        SELECT d.entity_id AS root_id, d.valid_from AS as_of, d.valid_to, d.entity_id AS current_id, 0 AS depth
        FROM dates d
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w.root_id, w.as_of, w.valid_to,
               CASE WHEN v_traversal = 'DOWN' THEN er.child_entity_id ELSE er.parent_entity_id END,
               w.depth + 1
        FROM walk w
        JOIN codes c ON c.ord = w.depth + 1
        JOIN entity_instances.entity_relationships er
          ON er.relationship_code = c.code
         AND er.system_to = golden_master.open_system_to()
         AND er.valid_from <= w.as_of AND er.valid_to >= w.as_of
         AND ((v_traversal = 'DOWN' AND er.parent_entity_id = w.current_id) OR (v_traversal <> 'DOWN' AND er.child_entity_id = w.current_id))
        WHERE w.depth < 8
    ),
    members AS (
        SELECT root_id, as_of, valid_to, current_id FROM walk
        WHERE depth = CASE WHEN v_traversal = 'SELF' OR COALESCE(cardinality(v_codes), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(cardinality(v_codes), 0) END
    ),
    measured AS (
        SELECT m.root_id, m.as_of, m.valid_to,
               (SELECT COALESCE(eav.golden_value_numeric, CASE WHEN eav.golden_value ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN eav.golden_value::NUMERIC END)
                FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
                JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = eav.attribute_id
                WHERE eav.entity_id = m.current_id AND ar.attribute_code = v_measure
                  AND eav.source_id = eav.golden_source_id AND eav.valid_from <= m.as_of AND eav.valid_to >= m.as_of
                  AND eav.system_to = golden_master.open_system_to() LIMIT 1) AS amount,
               (SELECT COALESCE(eav.golden_value_numeric, CASE WHEN eav.golden_value ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN eav.golden_value::NUMERIC END)
                FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
                JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = eav.attribute_id
                WHERE v_weight IS NOT NULL AND eav.entity_id = m.current_id AND ar.attribute_code = v_weight
                  AND eav.source_id = eav.golden_source_id AND eav.valid_from <= m.as_of AND eav.valid_to >= m.as_of
                  AND eav.system_to = golden_master.open_system_to() LIMIT 1) AS weight
        FROM members m
    )
    SELECT g.root_id, g.as_of, g.valid_to,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(g.amount) = 0 THEN NULL
                WHEN v_fn = 'MIN' THEN MIN(g.amount)
                WHEN v_fn = 'MAX' THEN MAX(g.amount)
                WHEN v_fn = 'WAVG' THEN SUM(g.amount * g.weight) / NULLIF(SUM(g.weight), 0)
                ELSE SUM(g.amount) END
    FROM measured g
    GROUP BY g.root_id, g.as_of, g.valid_to;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION golden_master.series_batch_slices(p_job_ids UUID[])
RETURNS TABLE(entity_id UUID, valid_from DATE, valid_to DATE, value NUMERIC)
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
    v_grain TEXT; v_traversal TEXT; v_codes TEXT[];
    v_amount VARCHAR(100); v_flow VARCHAR(100); v_terminal VARCHAR(100);
BEGIN
    SELECT cd.output_grain, amt.traversal, amt.relationship_codes, amt.attribute_code, flow.attribute_code, term.attribute_code
      INTO v_grain, v_traversal, v_codes, v_amount, v_flow, v_terminal
    FROM golden_master.calc_invalidations i
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_definitions cd ON cd.attribute_id = i.calc_attribute_id
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_inputs amt ON amt.calc_definition_id = cd.id AND amt.input_role = 'AMOUNT'
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_inputs flow ON flow.calc_definition_id = cd.id AND flow.input_role = 'FLOW_DATE'
    JOIN metadata_register.calc_inputs term ON term.calc_definition_id = cd.id AND term.input_role = 'TERMINAL'
    WHERE i.id = ANY (p_job_ids) LIMIT 1;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (
        SELECT * FROM golden_master.period_batch_dates(p_job_ids, v_grain)
    ),
    codes AS (
        SELECT hop.code, hop.ordinal::INTEGER AS ord
        FROM unnest(COALESCE(v_codes, ARRAY[]::TEXT[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS hop(code, ordinal)
    ),
    walk AS (
        SELECT d.entity_id AS root_id, d.valid_from AS as_of, d.valid_to, d.entity_id AS current_id, 0 AS depth
        FROM dates d
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w.root_id, w.as_of, w.valid_to,
               CASE WHEN v_traversal = 'DOWN' THEN er.child_entity_id ELSE er.parent_entity_id END,
               w.depth + 1
        FROM walk w
        JOIN codes c ON c.ord = w.depth + 1
        JOIN entity_instances.entity_relationships er
          ON er.relationship_code = c.code AND er.system_to = golden_master.open_system_to()
         AND er.valid_from <= w.as_of AND er.valid_to >= w.as_of
         AND ((v_traversal = 'DOWN' AND er.parent_entity_id = w.current_id) OR (v_traversal <> 'DOWN' AND er.child_entity_id = w.current_id))
        WHERE w.depth < 8
    ),
    members AS (
        SELECT root_id, as_of, valid_to, current_id FROM walk
        WHERE depth = CASE WHEN v_traversal = 'SELF' OR COALESCE(cardinality(v_codes), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(cardinality(v_codes), 0) END
    ),
    flows AS (
        SELECT m.root_id, m.as_of, m.valid_to,
               (SELECT COALESCE(eav.golden_value_date, CASE WHEN eav.golden_value ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' THEN left(eav.golden_value, 10)::DATE END)
                FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = eav.attribute_id
                WHERE eav.entity_id = m.current_id AND ar.attribute_code = v_flow AND eav.source_id = eav.golden_source_id
                  AND eav.valid_from <= m.as_of AND eav.valid_to >= m.as_of AND eav.system_to = golden_master.open_system_to() LIMIT 1) AS flow_date,
               (SELECT COALESCE(eav.golden_value_numeric, CASE WHEN eav.golden_value ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN eav.golden_value::NUMERIC END)
                FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = eav.attribute_id
                WHERE eav.entity_id = m.current_id AND ar.attribute_code = v_amount AND eav.source_id = eav.golden_source_id
                  AND eav.valid_from <= m.as_of AND eav.valid_to >= m.as_of AND eav.system_to = golden_master.open_system_to() LIMIT 1) AS amount
        FROM members m
    ),
    kept AS (
        SELECT root_id, as_of, valid_to, flow_date, amount FROM flows
        WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND flow_date IS NOT NULL AND flow_date <= as_of
        UNION ALL
        SELECT d.entity_id, d.valid_from, d.valid_to, d.valid_from,
               (SELECT COALESCE(eav.golden_value_numeric, CASE WHEN eav.golden_value ~ '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN eav.golden_value::NUMERIC END)
                FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = eav.attribute_id
                WHERE eav.entity_id = d.entity_id AND ar.attribute_code = v_terminal AND eav.source_id = eav.golden_source_id
                  AND eav.valid_from <= d.valid_from AND eav.valid_to >= d.valid_from AND eav.system_to = golden_master.open_system_to() LIMIT 1)
        FROM dates d
    ),
    solved AS (
        SELECT k.root_id, k.as_of, k.valid_to,
               golden_master.xirr(array_agg(k.flow_date ORDER BY k.flow_date, k.amount), array_agg(k.amount ORDER BY k.flow_date, k.amount)) AS rate
        FROM kept k WHERE k.amount IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY k.root_id, k.as_of, k.valid_to
    )
    SELECT d.entity_id, d.valid_from, d.valid_to, s.rate
    FROM dates d
    LEFT JOIN solved s ON s.root_id = d.entity_id AND s.as_of = d.valid_from;
END;
$$;

name: dq_handoff_all_overrides
statements:
-- Handoff can list every manual override in effect, and still flag the ones
-- whose value already matches the highest-ranked system source.

DO $patch$
DECLARE
  s text;
BEGIN
  SELECT pg_get_functiondef(oid) INTO s
  FROM pg_proc
  WHERE proname = 'data_quality_dashboard'
    AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(oid) LIKE '%timestamp with time zone%';

  IF s IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'data_quality_dashboard was not found';
  END IF;

  IF position('''ready'', o.ready' IN s) > 0 THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  s := replace(
    s,
    $old$
  override_matches AS (
    SELECT s.id AS entity_id,
           s.entity_code,
           s.entity_name,
           s.domain_code,
           ar.attribute_code,
           ar.attribute_name,
           m.golden_value AS override_value,
           m.override_reason,
           p.source_code AS priority_source_code,
           p.source_name AS priority_source_name,
           p.golden_value AS priority_value
    FROM manual_current m
    JOIN priority_current p
      ON p.entity_id = m.entity_id
     AND p.attribute_id = m.attribute_id
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = m.entity_id
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = m.attribute_id
    WHERE data_quality.values_match(m.golden_value, p.golden_value)
       OR (
         m.golden_value_numeric IS NOT NULL
         AND p.golden_value_numeric IS NOT NULL
         AND m.golden_value_numeric = p.golden_value_numeric
       )
  ),
$old$,
    $new$
  override_matches AS (
    SELECT s.id AS entity_id,
           s.entity_code,
           s.entity_name,
           s.domain_code,
           ar.attribute_code,
           ar.attribute_name,
           m.golden_value AS override_value,
           m.override_reason,
           p.source_code AS priority_source_code,
           p.source_name AS priority_source_name,
           p.golden_value AS priority_value,
           (
             p.entity_id IS NOT NULL
             AND (
               data_quality.values_match(m.golden_value, p.golden_value)
               OR (
                 m.golden_value_numeric IS NOT NULL
                 AND p.golden_value_numeric IS NOT NULL
                 AND m.golden_value_numeric = p.golden_value_numeric
               )
             )
           ) AS ready
    FROM manual_current m
    LEFT JOIN priority_current p
      ON p.entity_id = m.entity_id
     AND p.attribute_id = m.attribute_id
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = m.entity_id
    JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register ar ON ar.id = m.attribute_id
  ),
$new$
  );

  s := replace(
    s,
    $old$
  entity_override_matches AS (
    SELECT entity_id, count(*)::int AS match_count
    FROM override_matches
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
$old$,
    $new$
  entity_override_matches AS (
    SELECT entity_id,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE ready)::int AS match_count,
           count(*)::int AS override_count
    FROM override_matches
    GROUP BY entity_id
  ),
$new$
  );

  s := replace(
    s,
    'COALESCE(om.match_count, 0) AS "overrideMatchCount"',
    E'COALESCE(om.match_count, 0) AS "overrideMatchCount",\n           COALESCE(om.override_count, 0) AS "overrideCount"'
  );

  s := replace(
    s,
    '(SELECT count(*)::int FROM override_matches) AS override_match_count',
    '(SELECT count(*)::int FROM override_matches WHERE ready) AS override_match_count'
  );

  s := replace(
    s,
    '''priorityValue'', o.priority_value',
    E'''priorityValue'', o.priority_value,\n          ''ready'', o.ready'
  );

  s := replace(
    s,
    'ORDER BY o.entity_name, o.attribute_name',
    'ORDER BY o.ready DESC, o.entity_name, o.attribute_name'
  );

  s := replace(
    s,
    'OR e."qualityResolvedCount" > 0 OR e."qualityIntroducedCount" > 0',
    'OR e."qualityResolvedCount" > 0 OR e."qualityIntroducedCount" > 0 OR e."overrideCount" > 0'
  );

  IF position('''ready'', o.ready' IN s) = 0
     OR position('AS "overrideCount"' IN s) = 0
     OR position('count(*) FILTER (WHERE ready)' IN s) = 0
     OR position('FROM override_matches WHERE ready' IN s) = 0
     OR position('e."overrideCount" > 0' IN s) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Could not extend data_quality_dashboard with every manual override';
  END IF;

  EXECUTE s;
END;
$patch$;

  'Availability, DQ rule results, period movement, value changes, and manual overrides, resolved at the as-of dates and the knowledge time. Ready overrides match the highest-ranked system source. An entity id limits the run to that record.';
