statements:
-- The attribute editor pins Manual override at position 1 for every field.
-- Resolution was only doing that for calculated attributes, and it strips
-- MANUAL out of every saved sequence. A manual value now wins whenever one
-- is open, then a calculated result, then the template, attribute, or
-- data-source sequence.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION golden_master.preference_decision(
  p_entity_id uuid,
  p_attribute_id uuid,
  p_exclude_id uuid,
  p_extra_source_id uuid,
  p_extra_value text,
  p_extra_open boolean,
  OUT winner uuid,
  OUT tier text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = golden_master, entity_instances, metadata_register, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_template_id uuid;
  v_template_chain jsonb;
  v_column_chain jsonb;
  v_metadata jsonb;
  v_attribute_chain jsonb;
  v_chain text[];
  v_calculated boolean;
BEGIN
  SELECT eav.source_id INTO winner
  FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
  JOIN entity_instances.source_registry sr ON sr.id = eav.source_id
  WHERE eav.entity_id = p_entity_id
    AND eav.attribute_id = p_attribute_id
    AND eav.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude_id
    AND eav.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
    AND eav.system_to = TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31 23:59:59+00'
    AND sr.source_code = 'MANUAL'
    AND eav.golden_value IS NOT NULL
    AND btrim(eav.golden_value) <> '';

  IF winner IS NULL AND p_extra_open AND p_extra_value IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p_extra_value) <> '' THEN
    SELECT sr.id INTO winner
    FROM entity_instances.source_registry sr
    WHERE sr.id = p_extra_source_id
      AND sr.source_code = 'MANUAL';
  END IF;

  IF winner IS NOT NULL THEN
    tier := 'MANUAL_OVERRIDE';
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM metadata_register.calc_definitions cd
    WHERE cd.attribute_id = p_attribute_id
  ) INTO v_calculated;

  IF v_calculated THEN
    winner := NULL;
    SELECT eav.source_id INTO winner
    FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
    JOIN entity_instances.source_registry sr ON sr.id = eav.source_id
    WHERE eav.entity_id = p_entity_id
      AND eav.attribute_id = p_attribute_id
      AND eav.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude_id
      AND eav.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
      AND eav.system_to = TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31 23:59:59+00'
      AND sr.source_code = 'DERIVED'
      AND eav.golden_value IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(eav.golden_value) <> '';

    IF winner IS NULL AND p_extra_open AND p_extra_value IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p_extra_value) <> '' THEN
      SELECT sr.id INTO winner
      FROM entity_instances.source_registry sr
      WHERE sr.id = p_extra_source_id
        AND sr.source_code = 'DERIVED';
    END IF;

    IF winner IS NOT NULL THEN
      tier := 'CALCULATED';
      RETURN;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT me.template_id INTO v_template_id
  FROM entity_instances.master_entities me
  WHERE me.id = p_entity_id;

  IF v_template_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT taa.default_precedence_chain INTO v_template_chain
    FROM metadata_register.template_attribute_assignments taa
    WHERE taa.template_id = v_template_id
      AND taa.attribute_id = p_attribute_id;
  END IF;

  v_chain := golden_master.source_codes(v_template_chain);
  IF COALESCE(array_length(v_chain, 1), 0) > 0 THEN
    tier := 'TEMPLATE_SEQUENCE';
  ELSE
    SELECT ar.default_precedence_chain, ar.metadata
      INTO v_column_chain, v_metadata
    FROM metadata_register.attribute_register ar
    WHERE ar.id = p_attribute_id;

    v_attribute_chain := CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_column_chain) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(v_column_chain) > 0 THEN v_column_chain
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_metadata -> 'defaultPrecedenceChain') = 'array' THEN v_metadata -> 'defaultPrecedenceChain'
      ELSE '[]'::jsonb
    END;
    v_chain := golden_master.source_codes(v_attribute_chain);
    IF COALESCE(array_length(v_chain, 1), 0) > 0 THEN
      tier := 'ATTRIBUTE_SEQUENCE';
    ELSE
      SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(sr.source_code ORDER BY sr.precedence_rank, sr.source_code), ARRAY[]::text[])
        INTO v_chain
      FROM entity_instances.source_registry sr
      WHERE sr.is_active = true
        AND sr.source_code <> 'MANUAL';
      tier := 'DATA_SOURCE_SEQUENCE';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT picked.source_id INTO winner
  FROM (
    SELECT eav.source_id,
      COALESCE(array_position(v_chain, sr.source_code::text), 1000000 + COALESCE(sr.precedence_rank, 9999)) AS sort_key
    FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
    JOIN entity_instances.source_registry sr ON sr.id = eav.source_id
    WHERE eav.entity_id = p_entity_id
      AND eav.attribute_id = p_attribute_id
      AND eav.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude_id
      AND eav.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
      AND eav.system_to = TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31 23:59:59+00'
      AND eav.golden_value IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(eav.golden_value) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sr.id,
      COALESCE(array_position(v_chain, sr.source_code::text), 1000000 + COALESCE(sr.precedence_rank, 9999))
    FROM entity_instances.source_registry sr
    WHERE p_extra_open
      AND sr.id = p_extra_source_id
      AND p_extra_value IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(p_extra_value) <> ''
  ) picked
  ORDER BY picked.sort_key, picked.source_id
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION golden_master.preference_decision(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, text, boolean) IS
  'Winning source for the open value. Manual Entry wins when it has a value. A calculated result wins next. Otherwise the template sequence, the attribute sequence, then the data-source sequence.';

DO $backfill$
DECLARE
  r record;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT DISTINCT eav.entity_id, eav.attribute_id
    FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values eav
    JOIN entity_instances.source_registry sr ON sr.id = eav.source_id
    WHERE eav.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
      AND eav.system_to = TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31 23:59:59+00'
      AND sr.source_code = 'MANUAL'
      AND eav.golden_value IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(eav.golden_value) <> ''
      AND eav.golden_source_id IS DISTINCT FROM sr.id
  LOOP
    PERFORM golden_master.resolve_current_preference(r.entity_id, r.attribute_id);
  END LOOP;
END;
$backfill$;

-- How current relationship rows are actually stored, by parent and child type.
-- The chat agent uses this to choose lookup direction. Declared parent/child
-- on relationship_types can disagree with the rows (for example SECURITY_ISSUER).
-- SECURITY INVOKER so the caller's row access applies through the public views.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.relationship_link_counts()
RETURNS TABLE (
    relationship_code text,
    parent_domain_code text,
    child_domain_code text,
    link_count bigint
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
SET statement_timeout = '30s'
AS $$
    SELECT r.relationship_code::text,
           p.domain_code::text,
           c.domain_code::text,
           count(*)::bigint

-- Section order and cell size for entity attribute display.
-- Attributes render on a 4-column grid. Each attribute defaults to 1x1
-- and can span up to 4 columns and 3 rows.

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_span_columns SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (display_span_columns BETWEEN 1 AND 4),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_span_rows SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (display_span_rows BETWEEN 1 AND 3);

COMMENT ON COLUMN metadata_register.attribute_register.display_span_columns IS
  'Width of this attribute on the 4-column entity display. 1 is the default cell.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN metadata_register.attribute_register.display_span_rows IS
  'Height of this attribute on the entity display, in row tracks. 1 is the default.';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metadata_register.attribute_sections (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  domain_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL REFERENCES metadata_register.domain_types(domain_code),
  section_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  display_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  client_id UUID REFERENCES tenancy.clients(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

COMMENT ON TABLE metadata_register.attribute_sections IS
  'Named display sections for one entity type, in the order they appear on the attribute page.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION compliance.resolve_threshold(
    p_rule_id UUID,
    p_entity_id UUID,
    p_group TEXT,
    p_rank INTEGER,
    p_as_of DATE,
    p_fallback_soft NUMERIC,
    p_fallback_hard NUMERIC
) RETURNS TABLE (soft_limit NUMERIC, hard_limit NUMERIC, applies BOOLEAN, source TEXT)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE
AS $function$
    SELECT picked.soft_limit_value, picked.hard_limit_value, picked.applies, picked.source
    FROM (
        SELECT t.soft_limit_value, t.hard_limit_value, t.applies,
               CASE WHEN t.entity_id IS NULL THEN 'RULE' ELSE 'FUND' END AS source
        FROM compliance.rule_thresholds t
        WHERE t.rule_id = p_rule_id
          AND t.valid_from <= p_as_of AND t.valid_to >= p_as_of
          AND (t.entity_id = p_entity_id OR t.entity_id IS NULL)
          AND (t.group_value IS NULL OR t.group_value = p_group)
          AND (
                (t.rank_from IS NULL AND t.rank_to IS NULL)
                OR (
                    p_rank IS NOT NULL
                    AND t.rank_from IS NOT NULL
                    AND t.rank_from <= p_rank
                    AND (t.rank_to IS NULL OR p_rank <= t.rank_to)
                )
          )
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN t.entity_id = p_entity_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN t.group_value IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            CASE WHEN t.rank_from IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        LIMIT 1
    ) picked
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p_fallback_soft, p_fallback_hard, TRUE, 'VERSION'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM compliance.rule_thresholds t
        WHERE t.rule_id = p_rule_id
          AND t.valid_from <= p_as_of AND t.valid_to >= p_as_of
          AND (t.entity_id = p_entity_id OR t.entity_id IS NULL)
          AND (t.group_value IS NULL OR t.group_value = p_group)
          AND (
                (t.rank_from IS NULL AND t.rank_to IS NULL)
                OR (p_rank IS NOT NULL AND t.rank_from IS NOT NULL AND t.rank_from <= p_rank AND (t.rank_to IS NULL OR p_rank <= t.rank_to))
          )
    );
$function$;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION compliance.resolve_threshold(UUID, UUID, TEXT, INTEGER, DATE, NUMERIC, NUMERIC) TO authenticated;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'shared', (SELECT count(*) FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE domain_code IS NULL),
    'owned', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(domain_code, cnt)
      FROM (
        SELECT domain_code, count(*) AS cnt
        FROM metadata_register.attribute_register
        WHERE domain_code IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY domain_code

      FROM (
        SELECT domain_code, count(*) AS cnt
        FROM metadata_register.domain_templates
        WHERE is_active
        GROUP BY domain_code
      ) template_counts
    ), '{}'::jsonb)
  );
$$;

       '{"fromExpectedDraw":true}'::jsonb
FROM entity_instances.master_entities draw

LEFT JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values purpose
  ON purpose.entity_id = draw.id
 AND purpose.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE attribute_code = 'DRAW_PURPOSE')
 AND purpose.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
WHERE draw.domain_code = 'EXPECTED_DRAW'

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM entity_instances.master_entities existing
      WHERE existing.entity_code = 'PRIN-' || draw.entity_code
  );

INSERT INTO golden_master.entity_attribute_values (
    entity_id, attribute_id, source_id, golden_value,
    golden_value_numeric, golden_value_date, valid_from, valid_to, precedence_rank, metadata
)
SELECT sched.id,
       attr.id,
       src.source_id,
       field.val,
       CASE WHEN attr.data_type IN ('NUMBER', 'CURRENCY', 'PERCENTAGE', 'INTEGER', 'DECIMAL')
            AND field.val ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN field.val::numeric END,
       CASE WHEN attr.data_type = 'DATE' AND field.val ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN field.val::date END,
       DATE '2020-01-01',
       DATE '9999-12-31',
       100,
       '{"fromExpectedDraw":true}'::jsonb
FROM entity_instances.master_entities draw
JOIN entity_instances.master_entities sched ON sched.entity_code = 'PRIN-' || draw.entity_code
JOIN entity_instances.entity_relationships tranche_rel
  ON tranche_rel.parent_entity_id = draw.id
 AND tranche_rel.relationship_code = 'DRAW_TRANCHE'
 AND tranche_rel.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
JOIN entity_instances.master_entities tranche ON tranche.id = tranche_rel.child_entity_id
LEFT JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values size
  ON size.entity_id = tranche.id
 AND size.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE attribute_code = 'TRANCHE_SIZE')
 AND size.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
LEFT JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values hold
  ON hold.entity_id = tranche.id
 AND hold.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE attribute_code = 'TRANCHE_HOLD_PCT')
 AND hold.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
LEFT JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values unfunded
  ON unfunded.entity_id = tranche.id
 AND unfunded.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE attribute_code = 'TRANCHE_IS_UNFUNDED')
 AND unfunded.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
LEFT JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values share
  ON share.entity_id = draw.id
 AND share.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE attribute_code = 'DRAW_SHARE_PCT')
 AND share.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
LEFT JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values amount
  ON amount.entity_id = draw.id
 AND amount.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE attribute_code = 'DRAW_AMOUNT')
 AND amount.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
LEFT JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values draw_date
  ON draw_date.entity_id = draw.id
 AND draw_date.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE attribute_code = 'DRAW_DATE')
 AND draw_date.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
LEFT JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values draw_status
  ON draw_status.entity_id = draw.id
 AND draw_status.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM metadata_register.attribute_register WHERE attribute_code = 'DRAW_STATUS')
 AND draw_status.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values src ON src.id = COALESCE(amount.id, draw_date.id)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('AMORT_DATE', draw_date.golden_value),
    ('AMORT_TYPE', CASE WHEN unfunded.golden_value_boolean IS TRUE THEN 'DELAYED_DRAW' ELSE 'REVOLVER_DRAW' END),
    ('AMORT_PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT', (
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(size.golden_value_numeric, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(share.golden_value_numeric, 0) > 0
                THEN round(size.golden_value_numeric * share.golden_value_numeric / 100.0, 2)
            WHEN COALESCE(hold.golden_value_numeric, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(amount.golden_value_numeric, 0) > 0
                THEN round(amount.golden_value_numeric / (hold.golden_value_numeric / 100.0), 2)
            ELSE COALESCE(amount.golden_value_numeric, 0)
        END
    )::text),
    ('AMORT_PERCENT_OF_ORIGINAL', COALESCE(share.golden_value, '0')),
    ('AMORT_STATUS', CASE WHEN draw_status.golden_value = 'ACTUAL' THEN 'PAID' ELSE 'PROJECTED' END)
) AS field(code, val)
JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register attr ON attr.attribute_code = field.code
WHERE draw.domain_code = 'EXPECTED_DRAW'
  AND field.val IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values existing
      WHERE existing.entity_id = sched.id AND existing.attribute_id = attr.id
  );

statements:
-- Fund reconciliation reads a comparison from the prior certification.
-- The Halyard sample had stored those comparisons as extra attributes on the
-- current pack (a prior amount on each NAV line, and beginning balances on
-- the current roll-forward). Those figures are the same attributes, valid
-- through the prior period end. The open row stays the current period.

UPDATE metadata_register.attribute_register
SET description = 'Retired as a load for fund reconciliation. The prior amount is the administrator amount as of the prior certification.'
WHERE attribute_code = 'NAV_LINE_PRIOR';

UPDATE metadata_register.attribute_register
SET description = 'Retired as a load for fund reconciliation. The opening fair value is the position market value as of the prior certification.'
WHERE attribute_code = 'ROLL_BEGIN_FV';

UPDATE metadata_register.attribute_register
SET description = 'Retired as a load for fund reconciliation. The opening unrealized amount is the position unrealized gain as of the prior certification.'
WHERE attribute_code = 'ROLL_BEGIN_UNREALIZED';

UPDATE metadata_register.attribute_register
SET description = 'Retired as a load for fund reconciliation. The opening accrual is the position accrued interest as of the prior certification.'
WHERE attribute_code = 'ROLL_BEGIN_ACCRUED';

DELETE FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values
WHERE metadata->>'fundRecLookback' = 'true';

INSERT INTO golden_master.entity_attribute_values (
    entity_id, attribute_id, source_id, golden_value, golden_value_numeric,
    valid_from, valid_to, precedence_rank, metadata
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (me.id)
    me.id, admin_attr.id, prior_row.source_id, prior_row.golden_value,
    COALESCE(prior_row.golden_value_numeric, prior_row.golden_value::numeric),
    DATE '2020-01-01', DATE '2026-06-30', prior_row.precedence_rank,
    '{"fundRecLookback":"true","attribute":"NAV_LINE_ADMINISTRATOR"}'::jsonb
FROM entity_instances.master_entities me
JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register prior_attr ON prior_attr.attribute_code = 'NAV_LINE_PRIOR'
JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values prior_row
  ON prior_row.entity_id = me.id
 AND prior_row.attribute_id = prior_attr.id
 AND prior_row.system_to >= TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31'
 AND prior_row.golden_value IS NOT NULL
 AND prior_row.golden_value <> ''
JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register admin_attr ON admin_attr.attribute_code = 'NAV_LINE_ADMINISTRATOR'
WHERE me.entity_code LIKE 'HSCF2-LINE-%'
ORDER BY me.id, prior_row.system_from DESC;

INSERT INTO golden_master.entity_attribute_values (
    entity_id, attribute_id, source_id, golden_value, golden_value_numeric,
    valid_from, valid_to, precedence_rank, metadata
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (pos.id, opening.attribute_code)
    pos.id, opening.id, begin_row.source_id, begin_row.golden_value,
    COALESCE(begin_row.golden_value_numeric, begin_row.golden_value::numeric),
    DATE '2020-01-01', DATE '2026-06-30', begin_row.precedence_rank,
    jsonb_build_object('fundRecLookback', 'true', 'attribute', opening.attribute_code)
FROM entity_instances.entity_relationships rel
JOIN entity_instances.master_entities roll ON roll.id = rel.parent_entity_id
JOIN entity_instances.master_entities pos ON pos.id = rel.child_entity_id
JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register begin_attr
  ON begin_attr.attribute_code IN ('ROLL_BEGIN_FV', 'ROLL_BEGIN_ACCRUED', 'ROLL_BEGIN_UNREALIZED')
JOIN golden_master.entity_attribute_values begin_row
  ON begin_row.entity_id = roll.id
 AND begin_row.attribute_id = begin_attr.id
 AND begin_row.system_to >= TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-12-31'
 AND begin_row.golden_value IS NOT NULL
 AND begin_row.golden_value <> ''
JOIN metadata_register.attribute_register opening
  ON opening.attribute_code = CASE begin_attr.attribute_code
       WHEN 'ROLL_BEGIN_FV' THEN 'MARKET_VALUE'
       WHEN 'ROLL_BEGIN_ACCRUED' THEN 'ACCRUED_CASH_INTEREST_AMOUNT'
       ELSE 'UNREALIZED_GAIN_LOSS'
     END
WHERE rel.relationship_code = 'ROLL_POSITION'
  AND pos.entity_code LIKE 'HSCF2-POS-%'
ORDER BY pos.id, opening.attribute_code, begin_row.system_from DESC;

    FOR r IN

        FROM pg_constraint con

        JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = rel.relnamespace
        WHERE nsp.nspname = 'compliance'
          AND rel.relname = 'rules'
          AND con.contype = 'c'
          AND pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) ILIKE '%rule_category%'
    LOOP

    END LOOP;
END $$;

        'LEVERAGE', 'LIQUIDITY', 'FORTY_ACT', 'OTHER'
    ));

DO $$
DECLARE r record;
BEGIN
    FOR r IN
        SELECT con.conname
        FROM pg_constraint con
        JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid = con.conrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = rel.relnamespace
        WHERE nsp.nspname = 'compliance'
          AND rel.relname = 'rule_versions'
          AND con.contype = 'c'
          AND pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) ILIKE '%denominator_source%'
    LOOP

    END LOOP;
END $$;

name: relationship_link_side_counts
statements:
-- How many related records sit on each side of a stored link.
-- A list shows the other entity only when this side has one record.
-- Declared ONE_TO_ONE can still be many in the rows (an issuer has many deals).

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.relationship_link_counts();

CREATE FUNCTION public.relationship_link_counts()
RETURNS TABLE (
    relationship_code text,
    parent_domain_code text,
    child_domain_code text,
    link_count bigint,
    max_per_parent bigint,
    max_per_child bigint
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
SET statement_timeout = '30s'
AS $$
    WITH current_links AS (
        SELECT r.relationship_code::text AS relationship_code,
               p.domain_code::text AS parent_domain_code,
               c.domain_code::text AS child_domain_code,
               r.parent_entity_id,
               r.child_entity_id
        FROM entity_relationships r
        JOIN master_entities p ON p.id = r.parent_entity_id
        JOIN master_entities c ON c.id = r.child_entity_id
        WHERE r.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE
          AND r.valid_to >= CURRENT_DATE
          AND r.system_from <= now()
          AND r.system_to >= now()
    ), counted AS (
        SELECT relationship_code,
               parent_domain_code,
               child_domain_code,
               count(*) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY relationship_code, parent_domain_code, child_domain_code, parent_entity_id
               ) AS per_parent,
               count(*) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY relationship_code, parent_domain_code, child_domain_code, child_entity_id
               ) AS per_child
        FROM current_links
    )
    SELECT relationship_code,
           parent_domain_code,
           child_domain_code,
           count(*)::bigint AS link_count,
           max(per_parent)::bigint AS max_per_parent,
           max(per_child)::bigint AS max_per_child
    FROM counted
    GROUP BY relationship_code, parent_domain_code, child_domain_code;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.relationship_link_counts() IS
    'Current link counts by relationship code and stored parent and child types, plus the most records on either side.';

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.relationship_link_counts() TO authenticated;

statements:
-- Every catalog attribute belongs to one entity type. These five were inserted
-- before domain scoping, so a blank domain made them appear on every entity.
-- Give each one the entity its description and rules already use, unless that
-- entity already has an attribute with the same name. A same-name row is removed
-- only when nothing still points at it.

DO $$
DECLARE
  blocked text;
  remaining text;
BEGIN
  CREATE TEMP TABLE unscoped_attribute_homes (
    attribute_code text PRIMARY KEY,
    domain_code text NOT NULL
  ) ON COMMIT DROP;

  INSERT INTO unscoped_attribute_homes (attribute_code, domain_code) VALUES
    ('ANNUAL_INTEREST', 'SECURITY'),
    ('CASH_FLOWS', 'SECURITY'),
    ('YIELD_CURVE', 'SECURITY'),
    ('COST_BASIS', 'POSITION'),
    ('QUANTITY', 'POSITION');

  DELETE FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values AS value_row
  USING metadata_register.attribute_register AS attribute_row,
        unscoped_attribute_homes AS home,
        entity_instances.master_entities AS entity_row
  WHERE value_row.attribute_id = attribute_row.id
    AND attribute_row.attribute_code = home.attribute_code
    AND entity_row.id = value_row.entity_id
    AND entity_row.domain_code IS DISTINCT FROM home.domain_code;

  UPDATE metadata_register.attribute_register AS attribute_row
  SET domain_code = home.domain_code,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM unscoped_attribute_homes AS home
  WHERE attribute_row.attribute_code = home.attribute_code
    AND attribute_row.domain_code IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM metadata_register.attribute_register AS existing
      WHERE existing.domain_code = home.domain_code
        AND existing.id <> attribute_row.id
        AND lower(btrim(existing.attribute_name)) = lower(btrim(attribute_row.attribute_name))
    );

  SELECT string_agg(attribute_row.attribute_code, ', ' ORDER BY attribute_row.attribute_code)
  INTO blocked
  FROM metadata_register.attribute_register AS attribute_row
  JOIN unscoped_attribute_homes AS home ON home.attribute_code = attribute_row.attribute_code
  WHERE attribute_row.domain_code IS NULL
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM golden_master.entity_attribute_values AS value_row
        WHERE value_row.attribute_id = attribute_row.id
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM data_quality.dq_rules AS rule_row
        WHERE rule_row.attribute_id = attribute_row.id
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM metadata_register.calc_definitions AS calc_row
        WHERE calc_row.attribute_id = attribute_row.id
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM metadata_register.template_attribute_assignments AS assignment_row
        WHERE assignment_row.attribute_id = attribute_row.id
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM metadata_register.attribute_aliases AS alias_row
        WHERE alias_row.attribute_id = attribute_row.id
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM metadata_register.calc_inputs AS input_row
        WHERE input_row.attribute_code = attribute_row.attribute_code
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM entity_instances.source_attribute_values AS source_row
        WHERE source_row.attribute_id = attribute_row.id
      )
    );

  IF blocked IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Cannot remove unscoped attributes that already exist on their entity and still have data: %',
      blocked;
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM metadata_register.attribute_register AS attribute_row
  USING unscoped_attribute_homes AS home
  WHERE attribute_row.attribute_code = home.attribute_code
    AND attribute_row.domain_code IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM metadata_register.attribute_register AS existing
      WHERE existing.domain_code = home.domain_code
        AND existing.id <> attribute_row.id
        AND lower(btrim(existing.attribute_name)) = lower(btrim(attribute_row.attribute_name))
    );

  SELECT string_agg(attribute_code, ', ' ORDER BY attribute_code)
  INTO remaining
  FROM metadata_register.attribute_register
  WHERE domain_code IS NULL;

  IF remaining IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Attributes still have no entity: %', remaining;
  END IF;
END $$;

COMMENT ON COLUMN metadata_register.attribute_register.domain_code IS
  'Entity type that owns this attribute.';

      FROM (

          'attribute_name', attribute_name,
          'data_type', data_type,
          'description', description,

          'is_required', is_required,
          'is_multi_valued', is_multi_valued,
          'reference_domain_code', reference_domain_code,
          'reference_list_code', reference_list_code,
          'domain_code', domain_code,
          'client_id', client_id,
          'default_precedence_rank', default_precedence_rank,
          'is_derived', is_derived,
          'derivation_type', derivation_type,
          'derivation_formula', derivation_formula,
          'derivation_dependencies', derivation_dependencies,
          'display_format', display_format,
          'list_values', list_values,
          'validation_rules', validation_rules,
          'default_value', default_value,
          'display_section', display_section,
          'display_group', display_group,
          'display_span_columns', display_span_columns,
          'display_span_rows', display_span_rows,
          'is_editable', is_editable,
          'is_visible', is_visible,
          'aggregation_type', COALESCE(aggregation_type, 'NONE'),
          'weight_attribute_code', weight_attribute_code,
          'numeric_precision', numeric_precision
        ) AS attr_obj
        FROM metadata_register.attribute_register
        WHERE (p_domain_code IS NULL OR domain_code = p_domain_code)
        ORDER BY attribute_code
      ) sub
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_result;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$;

name: latest_fund_board_results
statements:
-- The fund-threshold board only needs the newest score for each fund, group,
-- and rank. Paging the append-only history (PostgREST caps a response at
-- max_rows) was a long series of round trips. One indexed read returns that
-- grain, and the JSON payload is a single row so the row cap does not truncate it.
--
-- A later run may score only one fund. DISTINCT ON keeps an older score for a
-- fund that the newer run did not touch. Scenario runs are excluded, matching
-- the board: a what-if score must not hide the book.

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compliance_results_latest_grain
    ON compliance.rule_evaluation_results (
        rule_id,
        anchor_entity_id,
        (COALESCE(group_by_value, '')),
        rank_position,
        evaluated_at DESC,
        id DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compliance_runs_scenario_rule
    ON compliance.rule_evaluation_runs (rule_id)
    WHERE COALESCE(metadata->>'scenario_code', '') <> '';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION compliance.latest_fund_board_results(p_rule_ids uuid[])
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
    WITH scenario_runs AS (
        SELECT run.id
        FROM compliance.rule_evaluation_runs AS run
        WHERE run.rule_id = ANY(p_rule_ids)
          AND COALESCE(run.metadata->>'scenario_code', '') <> ''
    ),
    latest AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (
            result.rule_id,
            result.anchor_entity_id,
            COALESCE(result.group_by_value, ''),
            result.rank_position
        )
            result.id,
            result.run_id,
            result.rule_id,
            result.rule_version_id,
            result.anchor_entity_id,
            result.group_by_value,
            result.as_of_date,
            result.knowledge_date,
            result.source_scope,
            result.numerator_value,
            result.denominator_value,
            result.computed_value,
            result.limit_direction,
            result.soft_limit_value,
            result.hard_limit_value,
            result.status,
            result.breach_amount,
            result.contributing_count,
            result.rank_position,
            result.evaluated_at
        FROM compliance.rule_evaluation_results AS result
        WHERE result.rule_id = ANY(p_rule_ids)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM scenario_runs
              WHERE scenario_runs.id = result.run_id
          )
        ORDER BY
            result.rule_id,
            result.anchor_entity_id,
            COALESCE(result.group_by_value, ''),
            result.rank_position,
            result.evaluated_at DESC,
            result.id DESC
    )
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(latest)), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM latest;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION compliance.latest_fund_board_results(uuid[]) IS
    'Newest non-scenario evaluation row for each fund, group, and rank. The fund-threshold board reads this instead of paging the result history. Audit detail stays on the result row and is not included.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION compliance.latest_fund_board_results(uuid[]) FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION compliance.latest_fund_board_results(uuid[]) FROM anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION compliance.latest_fund_board_results(uuid[]) TO authenticated, service_role;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
